newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures end sharply down on large-lot sales.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures end sharply down on large-lot sales.

text.p: The key March Japanese government bond futures contract ended sharply down on Wednesday, as the market mood was dampened by large-lot sales in the afternoon.
Traders said a spate of large-lot selling of the March totalling about 100 billion yen at around 126.20 triggered the plunge.
It was unclear where the selling was coming from, a trader at a city bank's securities affiliate said.
"There is talk that overseas hedge funds or foreign brokerage houses may have been the ones behind the selling," the trader said.
